title: stellaria borealis f. corollina
intro: Stellaria borealis f. corollina, commonly known as Northern Starwort, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Caryophyllaceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine, particularly in herbalism, for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Stellaria borealis f. corollina are attributed to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which help to soothe and protect the skin. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
